content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I have one minor suggestion before we move forward: - Regarding the relevant clause, the liability cap exceeds the total contract value, which increases potential financial exposure. We propose modifying this so that the aggregate liability of either party arising from this agreement shall be capped at the total fees paid or payable under this agreement. Please let me know if this adjustment works for you. Best regards,
